text:
sanjay: Quick ask — we need a 60m review for the new SDK auth flow + Console API surface. Goal: align on API semantics, SDK method naming, and rollout strategy. Who's available Tue/Wed next week? Pre-read: https://docs.redwood.ai/sdks/sdk-auth-proposal (please skim)

claire: I'm in. Prefer Tue afternoon (PST). Can we keep it to 45 if we focus scope? :raised_hands:

omar: Wed morning works better for me. Dropping PR refs here: #482 (sdk-auth), #489 (console-api). Also added perf notes in the doc.

jess: Adding UX artifacts to the proposal now — prototype links + annotated flows. Will call out where Console needs new toggles.

calendar-bot: Poll created — choose availability: Tue 3:00-4:00pm PT, Wed 9:00-10:00am PT, Thu 11:00-11:45am PT. Click to vote.

ryan: +1 for Tue 3pm. I can present SDK diff and walk through examples.

sanjay: OK locking Tue 3pm PT for now (tentative until poll clears). Draft agenda: 1) 10m context + success criteria; 2) 20m API contract & SDK surface; 3) 15m Console UX changes; 4) 15m rollout/canary + action items.

claire: tiny ask — reviewers please skim PRs #482, #489, #492 and add high-level comments in the doc before EOD Friday. Saves time in the meeting.

omar: assigning code review for #482 to @ryan and @jess. I'll add integration test notes and sequence diagrams.

jess: UX checklist added: prototype link, accessibility checklist, mobile/responsive states. Marked items that need design sign-off.

ryan: Pushing a minimal example for the new endpoint to the doc:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/sdk/auth \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \n  -d '{"client_id":"app-123","scopes":["read"]}'
```

sanjay: Please add any must-have discussion points to the pre-read by EOD Fri. If you can't make Tue, react with :x: so we can reschedule.

claire: added two items: auth session timeout policy and standardized error codes.

omar: noted — I'll prep a short migration & compatibility plan slide (5 min).

jess: prototype link and annotated flows are in the doc under "Console UX" section. Also flagged CTA placement concerns.

ryan: acked PR comments; will tidy up function names and examples before Tue.

sanjay: calendar invite + Zoom will go out once poll finalizes. tagging infra for networking checks: @infra-oncall — can you validate CORS & certs for the new endpoint?

infra-oncall: quick FYI — we'll validate CORS, TLS certs, and the new route in staging by Mon EOD. If you plan custom hostnames or ingress rules, ping me now.

sanjay: perfect, thanks all. If anyone wants to add a pre-read short slide (1-2) for context, add to the doc. Closing thread for coordination — react with :thumbsup: if you're set.
